scripts.dev:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { spawn } = require('child_process'); fs.rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); const child = spawn('npx', ['next', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); child.on('exit', (code) => process.exit(code ?? 0));"
scripts.build:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); fs.rmSync('.next', { recursive: true, force: true }); execSync('npx next build', { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
